# HALF 2 – Exploration and replication {#half-2-exploration-and-replication .darkslide background-color="rgba(0,0,0,0)"}

::: {.partlabel}
Second half
:::

::: notes
Welcome back. In the first half you reproduced a published number, which everyone could do because everyone ran the same code, and now you act as the sixth analyst and make choices of your own. We open the menu of decisions that any analysis of this claim has to take, you try a few of them on the slides, and we place what you tried among every justifiable specification on these data. Then we leave the original data behind for the new experiment that tested the claim again.
:::
